test_title: PYST 26: Selection Post (Matric Level) - English Language (Held On 30 June, 2023 Shift 4)
subject: english
question:
Select the option that expresses the given sentence in indirect speech.

Arya said, “I am very busy now.”

options.text: Arya said that she is being very busy now.
Arya said that she is be very busy now.
Arya said that she was very busy then.
Arya said that she was being very busy then.

solution:
The correct answer is '**Arya said that she was very busy then.**'
